# Error catalogue

Every failure this platform returns on purpose, generated by `make errors-doc` from the one `Reason`
table in `common/errors`. Change the table and regenerate in the same commit; CI fails on a stale
file.

## The contract

The problem+json `type` is always `about:blank`. No type URI namespace is published, and nothing
publishes a link into this file, so it promises no anchors and no URLs.

The `title` is the HTTP status phrase, which is what RFC 9457 asks for when the type is
`about:blank`. Per-reason prose lives here, never in a member a client parses.

An error's identity is (`domain`, `reason`), and `domain` is always `trader-joe`. Clients branch
on `reason`, and on nothing else; retryability is the reason's outcome in the table below, not a
field. A client must survive a reason it has never heard of.

The `detail` member is human text. It is never parsed.

`Retry-After`, `retry_after` and `reset_at` are present whenever the error carries a reset time.
`retry_after` is derived from `reset_at` when the answer is written, so a relayed error never
carries a delay that went stale on the way.

## Reasons

| Reason | Outcome | Disposition | HTTP status | gRPC code | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INVALID_REQUEST | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 422 | INVALID_ARGUMENT | The request did not match its declared schema; correct the fields the error lists and send it again. |
| UNSUPPORTED_ASSET_TYPE | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 422 | INVALID_ARGUMENT | The asset type or data type asked for is not supported; ask for a supported one instead. |
| UNSUPPORTED_INSTRUMENT | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 422 | INVALID_ARGUMENT | The broker cannot serve the instrument as specified, such as its currency or exchange; change the instrument and ask again. |
| FEED_NOT_AVAILABLE | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 422 | in-band on the FetchDataset ack, never a status | This deployment cannot serve the market-data feed asked for; ask for a feed it serves, or leave the feed unset. |
| VENDOR_INVALID_REQUEST | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 422 | INVALID_ARGUMENT | The market-data vendor refused the request as invalid, such as an end before its start; correct the request and send it again. |
| RANGE_IN_FUTURE | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 422 | INVALID_ARGUMENT | The range asked for starts at or after the current time, so there is no history to fetch; check the dates and their time zone. |
| VENDOR_REJECTED | REFUSED | PAGE | 422 | INVALID_ARGUMENT | The market-data vendor refused the request for a reason it does not document; do not retry it unchanged until an operator has looked. |
| NOT_FOUND | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 404 | NOT_FOUND | The entity named in the request does not exist; check the identifier, or create the entity first. |
| OWNER_MISMATCH | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 403 | PERMISSION_DENIED | The entity is not owned by the principal the request declares; act only on entities that principal owns. |
| OWN_OVERLAP_CONFLICT | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 409 | ALREADY_EXISTS | The request overlaps datasets the same owner already holds, listed in colliding_ids; extend one of those instead. |
| RANGE_COLLISION | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 409 | ALREADY_EXISTS | Growing the range would make the dataset identical to another the same owner holds, listed in colliding_ids; use that one instead. |
| RANGE_SHRINK | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 409 | FAILED_PRECONDITION | The update would shrink a dataset's range, and ranges only grow; delete the dataset and create a smaller one. |
| DUPLICATE_BAR_TIMESTAMP | REFUSED | CLIENT_FIX | 422 | INVALID_ARGUMENT | The batch carries two bars with the same timestamp; remove the duplicate and send the batch again. |
| DATABASE_INTEGRITY | REFUSED | PAGE | 409 | not rendered as a status | The database refused the write with a constraint violation the service did not foresee; do not retry it unchanged until an operator has looked. |
| RATE_BUDGET | NOT_READY | RECORD | 429 | FAILED_PRECONDITION | The service's own rate budget for the vendor cannot admit the request within its deadline; retry once reset_at has passed. |
| VENDOR_RATE_LIMITED | NOT_READY | PAGE | 429 | FAILED_PRECONDITION | The market-data vendor rate-limited the request even after retrying it; retry once reset_at has passed. |
| VENDOR_UNAVAILABLE | NOT_READY | RECORD | 503 | FAILED_PRECONDITION | The market-data vendor could not be reached, timed out, failed on its side, or its answer was cut off; retry later. |
| VENDOR_AUTH | NOT_READY | PAGE | 503 | FAILED_PRECONDITION | The service's credentials for the market-data vendor are missing or were refused; retry after an operator has fixed them. |
| DEADLINE | NOT_READY | RECORD | 504 | FAILED_PRECONDITION | A call to another service did not finish within its deadline; retry later, asking for less at once if it keeps happening. |
| PEER_UNAVAILABLE | NOT_READY | PAGE | 503 | not rendered as a status | Another service this request needs could not be reached, usually because it is down or restarting; retry later. |
| PEER_INTERNAL | NOT_READY | PAGE | 502 | not rendered as a status | Another service this request needs failed with an internal error, logged under error_id; retry later, and quote error_id if it persists. |
| PEER_PROTOCOL_ERROR | NOT_READY | PAGE | 502 | not rendered as a status | Another service sent a reply this one could not interpret, usually a version mismatch between them; retry once both run the same release. |
| DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE | NOT_READY | PAGE | 503 | not rendered as a status | The database could not be reached or dropped the connection; retry later. |
| DATABASE_CONFLICT | NOT_READY | RECORD | 503 | not rendered as a status | The write collided with a concurrent transaction and was rolled back; retry it. |

## Extension members

Beside `type`, `title`, `status` and `detail`, a problem body always carries `domain` and
`reason`, and carries these allowlisted members where the error has them -- and nothing else:

- `asset_symbol`
- `colliding_ids`
- `error_id`
- `feed`
- `granularity`
- `range_end`
- `range_start`
- `reset_at`
- `retry_after`
- `vendor`

## Reserved reasons

These names are fixed for later work and are **not** members today. Nothing raises them, and no
member may take one of them to mean something else:

- `OUTSIDE_LOOKBACK`
- `COVERAGE_GAP`
- `ADMISSION_REFUSED`
- `SUBSCRIBER_TOO_SLOW`
